title.zh: 将北萨马省卡塔曼市镇达拉基特小学的名称变更为Generoso Frigillana纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Dalakit Elementary School in the Municipality of Catarman, Province of Northern Samar, To Generoso Frigillana Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Dalakit Elementary School in the Municipality of Catarman, Province of Northern Samar, To Generoso Frigillana Memorial Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7462_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Dalakit Elementary School in Barangay Dalakit, Municipality of Catarman, Province of Northern Samar, is hereby changed to Generoso Frigillana Memorial Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
